note: Aircraft. kind is heli or plane. speed is top speed and stall the slowest a plane can fly, m/s; climb is a helicopter's rate up and down, m/s; turn is radians a second. gun_damage is per round, gun_gap seconds between rounds. rocket_damage and rocket_pen (mm of armour) are for each rocket out of a pod. east: true for Soviet aircraft (they carry Soviet-pattern pods, bombs and missiles). pylons is how many there are under EACH wing; stores is what may be hung on them (see scripts/ordnance.gd: none, pod8, pod16, bomb100, bomb500, bomb1000, aam); a 1000 kg bomb only ever goes on the innermost pylons. loadout is what it carries unless the player chooses otherwise, pylon by pylon from the left wing tip to the right. flares is how many times it can throw off a missile.

rows.name: AH-64 Apache
rows.about: Attack helicopter. Chin cannon and rocket pods. Can land on an objective to capture it.

rows.name: Mi-8
rows.about: Big transport helicopter with rocket pods or bombs. Tough and slow. Can land on an objective to capture it.

rows.name: F-86 Sabre
rows.about: Jet fighter. Six machine guns and two heat-seeking missiles for other aircraft. Fast; rearms only on its own airstrip.

rows.name: MiG-15
rows.about: Jet fighter. Three heavy cannon, slow to fire and hard hitting, and two heat-seeking missiles for other aircraft.

rows.name: A-1 Skyraider
rows.about: Propeller ground-attack plane. Slow, tough, and six pylons for rockets and bombs.

rows.name: Il-10
rows.about: Armoured propeller ground-attack plane. Heavy cannon and four pylons for rockets and bombs.
